message.commandkeys.placeholderFault: Message "%s" could not be sent because one or more placeholders failed to apply.
message.commandkeys.sendBlocked: Ratelimit exceeded by key %s. Ratelimit is set to %s activations in %s ticks.
option.commandkeys.macro.activation.HOLD: Macro will be activated once and remain active while its keybind is held.
option.commandkeys.macro.activation.VANI: Macro will be repeatedly activated and deactivated while its keybind is held (excluding mouse keybinds).
option.commandkeys.macro.bind.alt.toolti:
Alt keybind.
Used for reverse-cycling messages.
option.commandkeys.macro.conflict.ASSERT: If the key is already used by Minecraft, this keybind will be activated first, then the other keybind.
This keybind will not function in-game, but can be activated by pressing the key while on the profile options screen (if nothing is selected).
option.commandkeys.macro.conflict.SUBMIT: If the key is already used by Minecraft, this keybind will be cancelled.
option.commandkeys.macro.conflict.VETO.t: If the key is already used by Minecraft, the other keybind will be cancelled.
option.commandkeys.macro.control.hud.too: Briefly show the sent message/command as a pop-up above the hotbar.
Allow active macros to resume when their profile is reactivated.
option.commandkeys.macro.delay.individua: Time in ticks to wait after the key-press, before sending.
Time in ticks to wait after the previous message, before sending.
option.commandkeys.macro.delay.tooltip:
Delay in ticks before each message after the first.
Set to 0 to use per-message delays.
option.commandkeys.macro.delay.tooltip.r:
Delay in ticks between repeats.
If you set this to 40, each message will be sent every 40 ticks, offset from each other as specified by individual delays.
option.commandkeys.macro.send.CYCLE.tool:
Messages will be cycled through, one per key-press.
In this mode, you can send multiple messages in a single key-press by separating them with two commas e.g. /lobby,,/nick
option.commandkeys.macro.send.RANDOM.too: When the key is pressed, one of the messages will be randomly chosen and sent.
option.commandkeys.macro.send.REPEAT.too: Messages will be sent initially, then again at intervals of the specified delay.
option.commandkeys.macro.send.TYPE.toolt: The first message will be typed in chat, but not sent.
option.commandkeys.main.default.tooltip: These options will be used by new Macro instances.
option.commandkeys.main.exitWithoutSavin: Are you sure you want to exit without saving?
This will reload the configuration file to revert any changes you have made. If you have any active macros, they will be stopped.
option.commandkeys.main.profile.name: Name
option.commandkeys.main.profiles.default: This is the default profile for multiplayer
This is the default profile for singleplayer
option.commandkeys.main.profiles.tooltip:
Profiles are automatically activated when you join a world/server linked to a profile.
The default profiles are used when there is no linked profile.
Number of activations allowed in the specified timespan.
option.commandkeys.main.ratelimit.sp.too: If enabled, ratelimit will apply in singleplayer.
option.commandkeys.main.ratelimit.strict: If enabled, blocked activations will contribute to ratelimiting.
option.commandkeys.main.ratelimit.toolti: Limits activation rate to M activations in N ticks. Useful for preventing spam on servers.
option.commandkeys.profile.keys.tooltip: Activate a macro by pressing its keybind in-game, or on this screen if nothing is selected.
